objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Get code execution on the Struts 2 upload application and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The upload form is handled by the Jakarta multipart parser. What does it do with a Content-Type it can't parse?
Look up CVE-2017-5638 and how its error handling treats the header value.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework handles the upload form? (name only)

steps.title: Find the parser
steps.prompt: Which multipart parser does this version use by default for uploads?

steps.title: Find the injection point
steps.prompt: Which HTTP request header carries the value the server evaluates?

steps.title: Name the expression language
steps.prompt: In which expression language is that value evaluated? (acronym)
